name: tinycc
description: Tiny C Compiler - fast, lightweight C compiler with runtime compilation support

tcc.description: Tiny C Compiler for fast C compilation and execution, supports runtime compilation
tcc.usage:
tcc hello.c
tcc -o hello hello.c
tcc -run hello.c args
tcc -E hello.c
tcc -c hello.c

tiny-impdef.description: Generate import definition files (.def) from DLL files for TinyCC linking

tiny-libmaker.description: Create static library archives (.lib) from object files for TinyCC
tiny-libmaker.usage: tiny_libmaker library.lib object1.o object2.o\ntiny_libmaker mylib.lib *.o\ntiny_libmaker -v library.lib objects/*
